copy.tagline: 保护 CI/CD 流水线中的敏感凭据免遭泄露
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 CI/CD 中管理密钥却担心泄露风险
copy.tagline_en: Secure sensitive credentials in your CI/CD pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle secrets in CI/CD and worry about leaks

howto.what: Claude 会指导你在 CI/CD 流水线里安全存放和使用密钥:把 API 密钥、数据库密码等敏感信息放进 Vault、AWS Secrets Manager 等工具,并给出读取、轮换、日志脱敏和扫描的配置步骤。
howto.when: 当你处理敏感凭证、轮换密钥或加固 CI/CD 环境时触发。

say.text: 帮我把数据库密码存到 AWS Secrets Manager,部署时读取。
say.note: 会给出 AWS CLI 命令和步骤。

say.text: 在 GitHub Actions 里用 Vault 读取密钥,别写死在代码里。
say.note: 会生成 vault-action 配置示例。

say.text: 写一个自动轮换密钥的脚本。
say.note: 可能提供 AWS Lambda 或手动流程。

howto.what_en: Claude guides secure secrets management in CI/CD pipelines: storing API keys, DB passwords, etc. in Vault or AWS Secrets Manager, plus steps for retrieval, rotation, log masking, and scanning.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you handle sensitive credentials, rotate secrets, or secure CI/CD environments.

say_en.text: Help me store my database password in AWS Secrets Manager and read it during deployment.
say_en.note: Provides AWS CLI commands and steps.

say_en.text: Use Vault in GitHub Actions to fetch secrets, not hardcode them.
Write a script to rotate secrets automatically.
say_en.note: May provide an AWS Lambda or manual flow.
